newsitem.title: USA: Coach USA to buy four motorcoach cos.
newsitem.headline: Coach USA to buy four motorcoach cos.

text.p: Coach USA said on Thursday it made definitive agreements to merge with four motorcoach companies.

It said The companies include the businesses of Gray Line of Anaheim and Los Angeles, Powder River Transportation of Gillette, Wyo,. and Denver, Colo., Progressive Transportation based in Elmira, N.Y., and Gray Line of Montreal and Quebec City.
Three companies, having 1996 aggregate revenues of $38 million, will be accounted for as poolings of interests and require the approval of the Surface Transportation Board.
The fourth company will be accounted for as a purchase and requires the approval from the provincial transportation boards of Quebec and Ontario, the company said.

The current revenue "run rate" for Coach USA, including the four new companies, is estimated to be $260 million, compared with the 1995 revenues of the founding companies of $113 million, the company said.
